name: City Lodge Hotels Limited
summary: City Lodge Hotels Limited operates hotels in South Africa and internationally. The company operates hotels under the Courtyard, City Lodge, Fairview, Town Lodge, and Road Lodge brand names. It operates 5 Courtyard hotels with 381 rooms; 20 City Lodge hotels with 3,531 rooms; 14 Town Lodge hotels with 1,804 rooms; 22 Road Lodge hotels with 2,059 rooms; and 1 Fairview hotel with 127 rooms. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Bryanston, South Africa.
